title: Hypnotized by a Giggling Bimbo
description:
Sometimes I'm just so dumb and ditzy, but that doesn't make me any less hypnotic. In fact, giggling along with me as I tease your brains out will show you just how hypnotic I can be even in my most bimbo moments.

This file is all about being dumbed down to be just as much of a bimbo as I'm being. To realise all those big thoughts are no more important than which dress I wear or the makeup I like. Because you're just a big dummy anyway... and I want you to enjoy it, as you play with yourself and feel stupid after you listen.

CW: Hints of feminisation, but nothing concrete. Some gender identity play.
author: Mistress Calia
